limitations: The theorem is local and asymptotic and inherits the scale regime epsilon=o(delta^(5/2)). It does not provide a discrete causal-set anisotropic estimator, finite-scale statistical error bounds, or an optimized canonical full-tensor probe design. The finite full-curvature reconstruction is an algebraic identifiability result; originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from very recent parallel work.
record_title: Anisotropic Lorentz-Wasserstein probes recover timelike sectional curvature and the full curvature tensor
